# Third-party code

## lamejs.js

MP3 encoder: a JavaScript port of [LAME](https://lame.sourceforge.io/).

- Source: [`@breezystack/lamejs`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@breezystack/lamejs) 1.2.7 (`dist/lamejs.iife.js`), a maintained fork of [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs)
- License: LGPL-3.0

The file is unmodified and loaded as a separate script by `assets/js/mp3-worker.js`.
